package courseplan

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
)

// Legacy commands remain independently replayable. New commands also restore
// the first decision's audit bytes after a crash before Retry or Complete.
func (processor Processor) restorePinnedAudit(ctx context.Context, request *domain.CoursePlanRequest) error {
	checkpoints, ok := processor.Requests.(repository.PinnedCoursePlanRepository)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	input, err := checkpoints.GetPlanningInput(ctx, *request)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "PLANNING_INPUT_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
		}
		return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "PLANNING_INPUT_CHECKPOINT_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	if input.Validate(*request) != nil {
		return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "PLANNING_INPUT_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
	}
	request.CourseFingerprint = input.Fingerprint
	request.FingerprintVersion = domain.CourseFingerprintVersion
	request.NormalizedContextJSON = append(json.RawMessage(nil), input.NormalizedContext...)
	return nil
}

// processPinned consumes the durable first observation. It never refreshes the
// decision from live owner state; Student remains responsible for application fences.
func (processor Processor) processPinned(ctx context.Context, request *domain.CoursePlanRequest, input domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint, checkpoints repository.PinnedCoursePlanRepository) error {
	result := DeterministicResult{Course: input.Draft, Fingerprint: input.Fingerprint, NormalizedContext: input.NormalizedContext, GapTargets: input.GapTargets}
	policy := input.Policy
	learningPathState := input.OriginalPath
	request.CourseFingerprint = result.Fingerprint
	request.FingerprintVersion = domain.CourseFingerprintVersion
	request.NormalizedContextJSON = result.NormalizedContext
	if len(result.GapTargets) == 0 {
		if learningPathState != nil {
			request.ResultCode = domain.CoursePlanResultNoGap
			command := domain.LearningPathCompletion{
				Schema: domain.LearningPathNoGapRequestSchema, LearningPathID: learningPathState.LearningPathID,
				PlanningRequestID: request.ID, CourseID: learningPathState.CourseID,
				GoalCode: request.GoalCode, CourseFingerprint: learningPathState.CourseFingerprint,
				PlannerPolicyVersion: policy.PlannerVersion, ReasonCode: "mastery_no_gap",
				ReasonSummary: request.Intent.DesiredOutcome, ExpectedVersion: learningPathState.PathVersion,
			}
			checkpoint, checkpointErr := domain.NewLearningPathNoGapCheckpoint(
				*request, command, processor.Clock.Now().UTC(),
			)
			if checkpointErr != nil {
				return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, domain.CoursePlanFailureCheckpoint)
			}
			return processor.checkpointAndDispatchLearningPathCommand(ctx, request, checkpoint)
		}
		request.ResultCode = domain.CoursePlanResultNoGap
		if err := processor.renewClaim(ctx, *request); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return processor.Requests.Complete(ctx, *request, request.ClaimToken, processor.Clock.Now().UTC())
	}
	artifact, err := checkpoints.GetGeneratedCourse(ctx, *request)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		// Enrichment mutates nested lesson slices. Keep the pinned draft immutable.
		rawDraft, cloneErr := json.Marshal(input.Draft)
		var generationDraft domain.GeneratedCourse
		if cloneErr != nil || json.Unmarshal(rawDraft, &generationDraft) != nil {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "PLANNING_INPUT_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
		}
		generatedCourse, generationErr := GenerateCourseContent(ctx, processor.Generator, request.ID, generationDraft, input.NormalizedContext,
			func(ctx context.Context) error { return processor.renewClaim(ctx, *request) })
		if generationErr != nil {
			if errors.Is(generationErr, domain.ErrConflict) {
				return generationErr
			}
			return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "CONTENT_GENERATION_UNAVAILABLE", generationErr)
		}
		artifact, err = domain.NewGeneratedCourseCheckpoint(input, generatedCourse)
		if err != nil {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "GENERATED_COURSE_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
		}
		if err := processor.renewClaim(ctx, *request); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := checkpoints.CheckpointGeneratedCourse(ctx, *request, artifact, processor.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	} else if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "GENERATED_COURSE_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
		}
		return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "GENERATED_COURSE_CHECKPOINT_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	if artifact.Validate(input) != nil {
		return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "GENERATED_COURSE_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
	}
	request.GeneratedCourseJSON, err = json.Marshal(artifact.Course)
	if err != nil {
		return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "GENERATED_COURSE_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
	}
	receipt, err := checkpoints.GetCourseEnsure(ctx, *request)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		if err := processor.renewClaim(ctx, *request); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		courseResult, ensureErr := processor.Courses.EnsureCourse(ctx, artifact.Course, request.ID)
		if ensureErr != nil {
			return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "COURSE_UNAVAILABLE", ensureErr)
		}
		receipt, err = domain.NewCourseEnsureCheckpoint(input, artifact, courseResult)
		if err != nil {
			return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "COURSE_INVALID_RESPONSE", err)
		}
		if err := processor.renewClaim(ctx, *request); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := checkpoints.CheckpointCourseEnsure(ctx, *request, receipt, processor.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	} else if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "COURSE_ENSURE_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
		}
		return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "COURSE_ENSURE_CHECKPOINT_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	if receipt.Validate(input, artifact) != nil {
		return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "COURSE_ENSURE_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
	}
	courseResult := receipt.Result
	if err := processor.renewClaim(ctx, *request); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if request.DiagnosticPlanID == "" {
		if err := processor.Students.AssignCourse(ctx, request.StudentID, courseResult.CourseID, request.ID, request.ID); err != nil {
			return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "ASSIGNMENT_UNAVAILABLE", err)
		}
	}
	items := make([]domain.LearningPathItem, len(courseResult.Lessons))
	for index, lesson := range courseResult.Lessons {
		status := domain.LearningPathItemPlanned
		reason := "prerequisite_sequence"
		if index == 0 {
			status = domain.LearningPathItemReady
			reason = "first_current_gap"
		}
		items[index] = domain.LearningPathItem{
			ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: lesson.LessonID, LessonRevisionID: lesson.LessonRevisionID, Position: index,
			Status: status, Targets: lesson.Targets, ReasonCode: reason,
		}
	}
	reasonCode := "initial_plan"
	if request.Intent.Reason == domain.PlanningReasonReplan {
		reasonCode = "mastery_replan"
	}
	if err := processor.renewClaim(ctx, *request); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if learningPathState != nil {
		items = preserveAssignmentIdentities(items, learningPathState.Items)
		command := domain.LearningPathReplan{
			Schema: domain.LearningPathReplanRequestSchema, LearningPathID: learningPathState.LearningPathID,
			PlanningRequestID: request.ID, CourseID: courseResult.CourseID, GoalCode: request.GoalCode,
			CourseFingerprint: result.Fingerprint, PlannerPolicyVersion: policy.PlannerVersion,
			ReasonCode: reasonCode, ReasonSummary: request.Intent.DesiredOutcome,
			ExpectedVersion: learningPathState.PathVersion, Items: items,
		}
		request.CourseID = courseResult.CourseID
		request.Reused = courseResult.Reused
		if courseResult.Reused {
			request.ResultCode = domain.CoursePlanResultReused
		} else {
			request.ResultCode = domain.CoursePlanResultCreated
		}
		checkpoint, checkpointErr := domain.NewLearningPathReplanCheckpoint(
			*request, command, processor.Clock.Now().UTC(),
		)
		if checkpointErr != nil {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, domain.CoursePlanFailureCheckpoint)
		}
		return processor.checkpointAndDispatchLearningPathCommand(ctx, request, checkpoint)
	} else {
		if request.DiagnosticPlanID != "" {
			if processor.InitialAllocations == nil {
				return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "INITIAL_ALLOCATION_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
			}
			checkpoint := domain.InitialAllocationCheckpoint{StudentID: request.StudentID, RequestID: request.ID, DiagnosticPlanID: request.DiagnosticPlanID, Reused: courseResult.Reused, Replacement: domain.LearningPathReplacement{PlanningRequestID: request.ID, CourseID: courseResult.CourseID, GoalCode: request.GoalCode, CourseFingerprint: result.Fingerprint, PlannerPolicyVersion: policy.PlannerVersion, ReasonCode: reasonCode, ReasonSummary: request.Intent.DesiredOutcome, ExpectedVersion: 0, Items: items}}
			checkpoint.Replacement.ExpectedOnboardingVersion = input.ExpectedOnboardingVersion
			checkpoint.Replacement.ExpectedDirectionCode = input.ExpectedDirectionCode
			if err := processor.InitialAllocations.CheckpointInitialAllocation(ctx, *request, checkpoint, processor.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			return processor.dispatchInitialAllocation(ctx, request, checkpoint)
		}
		allocation, err := processor.Students.CreateLearningPath(ctx, request.StudentID, request.ID, domain.LearningPathReplacement{
			PlanningRequestID: request.ID, CourseID: courseResult.CourseID, GoalCode: request.GoalCode,
			CourseFingerprint: result.Fingerprint, PlannerPolicyVersion: policy.PlannerVersion,
			ReasonCode: reasonCode, ReasonSummary: request.Intent.DesiredOutcome, ExpectedVersion: 0, Items: items,
		})
		if err != nil {
			return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "LEARNING_PATH_UNAVAILABLE", err)
		}
		if allocation.StudentID != request.StudentID || allocation.CourseID != courseResult.CourseID ||
			allocation.GoalCode != request.GoalCode || allocation.CourseFingerprint != input.Fingerprint ||
			allocation.LearningPathID == "" || (request.LearningPathID != "" && request.LearningPathID != allocation.LearningPathID) {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "INITIAL_ALLOCATION_RECEIPT_INVALID")
		}
		request.LearningPathID = allocation.LearningPathID
		if err := processor.Requests.ResolveLearningPath(
			ctx, request.ID, request.ClaimToken, request.LearningPathID, processor.Clock.Now().UTC(),
		); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	request.CourseID = courseResult.CourseID
	request.Reused = courseResult.Reused
	if courseResult.Reused {
		request.ResultCode = domain.CoursePlanResultReused
	} else {
		request.ResultCode = domain.CoursePlanResultCreated
	}
	if err := processor.renewClaim(ctx, *request); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return processor.Requests.Complete(ctx, *request, request.ClaimToken, processor.Clock.Now().UTC())
}
